g.text: Does the token's OWN attribution help?

text.style: font-size: 21.75px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Attribution gating — scaling components by their attribution to the token

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Attribution is the GIM sensor the decomposition was built from: a single modified backward (τ=2 softmax Jacobian, scaling/4 on Q and K, halved

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: gate/up gradients, frozen RMSNorm statistics) against a PRE-softmax objective that puts one unit of reward on each ground-truth next-token logit —

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: not plain gradients and not integrated gradients. A component's score at token t is Σ|∂Reward/∂W · W| over the entries it owns. Weights are shared

text.style: font-size: 13.92px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: across positions, so this is one weight rebuild and one forward per position: 24 positions × 46 configurations in 168 s.
